Name: Sherebiah
Summary: A Levite of understanding whom Ezra brought from Casiphia; he guarded the temple treasure on the journey and later taught the Law and sealed the covenant.
KeyVerses: Ezra 8:18; Ezra 8:24; Nehemiah 8:7; Nehemiah 9:4; Nehemiah 9:5; Nehemiah 10:12; Nehemiah 12:8; Nehemiah 12:24
LifeLesson: Understanding and trustworthiness go together in God's service.
RelatedEvents: Ezra Reads the Law; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
